all_quotes.quote: We present results of continuum and spectral line observations with ALMA and 22 GHz water (H$_2$O) maser observations using KaVA and VERA toward a high-mass star-forming region, G25.82–0.17.

The systemic velocity of G25.82–0.17 is 93.7 km s$^{-1}$ from ammonia (the NH$_3$ (1,1) line) observations using the Effelsberg 100 m telescope (cite: wienen12), with a corresponding kinematic distance of 5 $\pm$ 0.3 kpc (cite: green11).

To investigate the mechanism of high-mass star formation in the G25.82 region, we carried out 1.3 mm continuum and spectral line observations with ALMA and 22 GHz H$_2$O maser observations using KaVA and VERA.
